system.description: • Effect: Your Sneak Attack hits on a creature you have a Dossier on open a wound: it loses 1d6 HP at the start of each of its turns until healed or bandaged (one wound at a time; against a solo, the bleeding ends when it becomes Bloodied), and it regains HP at half the normal rate, magical healing included. Creatures that don't bleed are unaffected.

rules.value: Marked for Death (Improved): a Sneak Attack hit on a creature you have a Dossier on opens a wound: it loses 1d6 HP at the start of each of its turns until healed or bandaged, and regains HP at half rate (one wound at a time; a solo stops bleeding when Bloodied).
